02c8cc8fafd54d75.description: Job Description: IT Technician Employment Type: Full-Time About the Role We are looking for a skilled and hands-on IT Technician to provide technical support across desktop systems, hardware, software, and network infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills and a good understanding of system integration, particularly the integration of Oracle NetSuite with ZenHR . Key Responsibilities Provide desktop and laptop support, including hardware diagnostics, troubleshooting, software installation, and peripheral configuration. Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, and end-user devices. Troubleshoot network connectivity issues involving LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and Wi-Fi. Support system integration activities, particularly connecting Oracle NetSuite with ZenHR, and assist in troubleshooting related integration issues. Monitor and resolve IT incidents independently within the assigned scope, escalating complex issues when necessary. Maintain accurate documentation of technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions. Provide technical assistance to employees and ensure reliable day-to-day IT operations. 024c9270455b4393.description: Master Works is a Saudi technology company driving digital transformation through emerging technologies and innovative digital solutions. We empower organizations with expertise across data management, AI, software development, and digital strategy, contributing to the digital economy in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Master Works is looking for a Data, Senior Engineer to design, develop, and maintain data integration solutions, data warehouse architectures, and Business Intelligence systems. The role focuses on data extraction, transformation, reporting, database development, and visualization to support business needs and data-driven decision-making. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Business Intelligence, data integration, and data warehouse solutions. Build and manage ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from multiple structured and unstructured sources. Develop, deploy, and maintain reports and dashboards using reporting and data visualization tools. Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and database objects. Design and develop relational and multidimensional database architectures. Monitor, debug, and troubleshoot data pipelines, databases, and BI solutions. Implement data warehouse concepts, tools, and best practices. Develop data visualization solutions to present complex data effectively. Gather and translate business and client requirements into technical and functional specifications. Establish and maintain development standards aligned with enterprise architecture guidelines. Modify database structures and data solutions to meet client requirements. Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 3 years of experience in data engineering, database development, or Business Intelligence. Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as SSIS, DTS, or SSAS, with SSIS preferred. Minimum 3 years of experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SQL, T-SQL, stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, indexes, query optimization, and relational database management systems (RDBMS). Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, AWS QuickSight, or similar platforms. Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, relational and multidimensional databases, and data integration architectures. Strong ability to write, analyze, debug, and optimize SQL queries. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, attention to detail, communication, and collaboration skills. Good command of English and the ability to communicate technical information effectively.

02bbb1ccb4daeb4d.job_title: Step Up Your Pastry Career: Junior Pastry Sous Chef - Al Khobar
02bbb1ccb4daeb4d.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Head Chef / Head Pastry Chef) Compensation: 7,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this upscale kitchen is looking for a driven pastry professional to bring quiet excellence and creativity to their pastry section. The Role As a Junior Pastry Sous Chef, you will support the Head Pastry Chef in managing the pastry section. You will take ownership of daily production—ranging from delicate viennoiserie to refined plated desserts—while maintaining uncompromising quality, developing the junior team, and confidently stepping up to lead the section when needed. Your Profile & Experience Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated pastry experience, with at least 2 to 3 years serving as a Chef de Partie Pastry or senior pastry cook within a fine dining or upscale restaurant setting. Technical Foundation: Deep, hands-on knowledge of viennoiserie, doughs, creams, chocolate work, and fillings, alongside a strict understanding of shelf life, storage protocols, and allergen controls. Traits: Precise, creative, and quietly excellent. You are cost-aware and focused on consistency. Language: English fluency is mandatory. Additional skills in French or another European language are highly advantageous. Core Responsibilities Pastry Techniques: Execute classic and contemporary pastry techniques with precision, care, and a highly refined eye for presentation. Leadership & Mentoring: Actively participate in motivating and developing the pastry team, maintain discipline during busy services, and lead the section with confidence in the Head Pastry Chef's absence. Production & Storage: Plan daily production, rigorously monitor shelf life, maintain strict FIFO and labeling standards, and flawlessly execute freezing and defrosting procedures. Hygiene & Quality: Ensure every item leaving the section meets strict standards for taste, texture, and visual appeal while keeping the workspace clean, safe, and fully compliant. Cost & Inventory Control: Monitor stock levels, manage portion controls, and minimize waste, ensuring premium quality is maintained without losing sight of food costs.

The company achieves this through a network of over 250 proprietary offices and a team of more than 3,000 professionals, combining worldwide infrastructure with local expertise. 02b0526fe6d6b70e.description: About Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. is a key delivery partner for one of Saudi Arabia’s flagship giga-projects, a central pillar of Vision 2030. This landmark development, located approximately 45 km southwest of Riyadh, is designed as the Kingdom’s future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture, aiming to diversify the economy and enhance quality of life. Role Overview The Fire Life Safety Manager will support the end-to-end delivery of fire and life safety assurance across a diverse portfolio of city assets. This full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, covers the complete asset lifecycle, including design, construction, commissioning, handover, operational readiness, and buildings in use. The role requires over 10 years of experience and involves providing competent technical and operational leadership, undertaking fire risk assessments, and delivering risk-based inspection and audit programs. Key Responsibilities Lead fire and life safety assurance across the full asset lifecycle, including design, construction, commissioning, handover, operational readiness, and buildings in use. Plan, undertake, and document fire risk assessments across operational assets, construction sites, event spaces, temporary facilities, and back-of-house environments. Maintain fire risk assessment programs and risk registers, tracking residual risks, corrective actions, interim controls, overdue items, and risk acceptance decisions. Deliver risk-based fire and life safety inspections and technical audits covering means of escape, compartmentation, fire stopping, structural fire protection, fire doors, smoke control, suppression, detection, alarm, emergency lighting, firefighting access, and fire water systems. Identify, risk-rank, and manage fire safety deficiencies, ensuring corrective actions are supported by clear technical evidence and verified before close-out. Review tenant, operator, contractor, event, and temporary fit-out proposals, and monitor compliance with hot work, fire watch, impairment management, permit-to-work, and construction fire safety requirements. Act as a rostered tactical Silver commander during fire, evacuation, and life safety incidents, establishing command arrangements and coordinating with relevant emergency services and asset operators. Lead evacuation management, incident reporting, decision logging, operational debriefs, and lessons-learned activities following incidents, exercises, and major drills. Review fire strategies, engineering reports, performance-based designs, shop drawings, hydraulic calculations, cause-and-effect matrices, alarm zoning, and proposed alternative solutions. Witness and verify the commissioning and integrated testing of fire detection, alarm, voice alarm, suppression, smoke control, fire pump, and fire water systems. Assess asset readiness before handover, activation, and public opening, providing recommendations on outstanding deficiencies, interim mitigation measures, and go or no-go decisions. Investigate incidents and system failures, analyze performance trends, prepare technical reports and assurance dashboards, and support stakeholder engagement, training, exercises, and capability development. Required Qualifications and Experience Demonstrable experience completing and signing off fire risk assessments for complex, high-occupancy, or high-consequence environments. 020798caa266f4b4.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز نمو التخصصي للتأهيل في نجران عن أخصائي علاج وظيفي للانضمام إلى فريقه. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى مساعدة المرضى على تحسين قدراتهم على أداء مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل، بالإضافة إلى تعليم الأفراد ذوي الإعاقات الدائمة كيفية استخدام المعدات التكيفية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم على تنفيذ مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل. تدريب المرضى على أداء الأنشطة اليومية مثل ارتداء الملابس والطهي وتناول الطعام. استخدام التمارين البدنية لزيادة القوة واستعادة البراعة الجسدية والتغلب على مشاكل التنسيق الحركي. تعليم ذوي الإعاقات الدائمة كيفية استخدام معدات التكيف، بما في ذلك الكراسي المتحركة والجبائر، والأدوات الخاصة المساعدة في تناول الطعام وارتداء الملابس. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. القدرة على مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم الوظيفية. معرفة بمعدات التكيف وكيفية تعليم استخدامها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. القدرة على تطوير خطط علاج فردية. الالتزام بالتطوير المهني ومواكبة أحدث الممارسات في العلاج الوظيفي. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العلاج الوظيفي ضمن فريق متخصص في مركز نمو التخصصي للتأهيل بمدينة نجران. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع المرضى لتقديم الدعم والعلاج اللازمين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

02614534c5947092.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع أنشطة الصيانة، بما في ذلك التخطيط والتنفيذ والتقييم، لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لإتمامها. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم الفردية. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة بشكل دوري، وتقييم إنجازاتهم لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة عند الحاجة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية عمل المعدات والأنظمة. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بأنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي ذي صلة. فهم قوي لمبادئ الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات وتوزيع المهام بفعالية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. مهارات ممتازة في التنظيم وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمل بدقة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جازان. سيعمل المشرف ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات، وستكون مسؤولياته محورية لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة عمليات الصيانة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

Support hot-work control procedures and ensure that fire watches and appropriate firefighting equipment are provided as required. Maintain current area occupancy information and assist in the preparation of evacuation plans and warden coverage maps. Lead orderly evacuations, sweep assigned zones when safe, guide personnel to designated muster points, and report status to incident command. Participate in safety drills, document performance, and follow up on corrective actions. Provide fire-awareness briefings and assist with induction and toolbox-talk programs. Refrain from undertaking firefighting activities beyond the level of training or where personal safety may be compromised. Required Experience A minimum of 2 years and a maximum of 5 years of experience in fire safety or a related field. Work Environment and Compensation This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The salary for this role ranges from SAR 7,500 to SAR 11,250, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position to contribute to our ongoing projects and safety initiatives.

0260c2792b1970bc.description: About the Role Malaa is seeking a Finance Manager to lead the daily finance function for Credit Line and relevant Malaa entities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role ensures accurate accounting, timely financial and regulatory reporting, disciplined liquidity management, effective internal controls, and compliance with IFRS, SAMA, CMA, ZATCA, Saudi Companies Law, and approved Group policies. The Finance Manager will support the Group CFO by providing reliable management information, coordinating budgeting, managing audit processes, supervising the finance team, and driving continuous process improvement. Key Responsibilities Manage the general ledger and oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, including journal review, accruals, provisions, prepayments, depreciation, amortisation, reclassifications, and consolidation submissions. Prepare and review management accounts, statutory financial statements, balance-sheet reconciliations, cash-flow reporting, and analysis of material movements and variances. Ensure appropriate IFRS accounting for financing activities, revenue and fees, financial instruments and ECL, leases, intangible assets, related parties, provisions, and entity-specific transactions. Coordinate annual budgets, rolling forecasts, long-range plans, and monthly budget-versus-actual reporting across business and support functions. Manage daily cash positioning, liquidity forecasts, funding requirements, payment planning, bank accounts, authorised signatories, and treasury controls. Coordinate accurate and timely SAMA, CMA, and other regulatory returns, ensuring reconciliation to the general ledger and documented data lineage. Oversee VAT, withholding tax, zakat or corporate tax schedules and filings, including correct treatment of domestic and cross-border transactions. Oversee vendor onboarding, purchase orders, invoice processing, employee expenses, payment runs, and open-commitment reporting. Maintain finance policies, procedures, process narratives, risk and control matrices, and close checklists. Lead finance support for internal and external audits, prepare schedules and technical responses, and ensure timely remediation of findings. Oversee effective use of the accounting or ERP system, chart of accounts, master data, posting rules, user access, interfaces, workflows, and period controls. Supervise, coach, and develop finance staff, allocating work and reviewing deliverables. Act as the principal finance contact for Operations, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Technology, Procurement, Human Resources, and other business functions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in finance management. Demonstrated experience in financial accounting, reporting, budgeting, and performance management. Strong understanding of treasury, liquidity management, and reconciliations. Proven ability to ensure regulatory, tax, and statutory compliance. Experience with payables, procurement, and expense governance. Proficiency in internal controls, audit coordination, and governance. Experience with finance systems and process improvement initiatives. Leadership experience with the ability to supervise and develop finance staff. Required Skills In-depth knowledge of IFRS, SAMA, CMA, ZATCA, and Saudi Companies Law. Strong analytical skills for financial insight and variance analysis. Ability to challenge assumptions and validate inputs effectively. Excellent communication skills for presenting financial results and regulatory implications. Proficiency in accounting/ERP systems and financial reporting tools. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring active collaboration with various business and support functions across the organisation.

026ad06c30338969.job_title: Passenger Service Agent Flynas YNB Station
026ad06c30338969.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a Passenger Service Agent to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Taif and Makkah. This full-time role involves providing essential passenger and customer services as contracted, ensuring a smooth and positive experience for travelers. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Prepare and clear check-in counters with appropriate stationery and signage before and after flights. Provide a welcoming service to passengers at check-in and other customer service touchpoints. Verify travel documentation and check-in departing passengers according to standard operating procedures. Counter-check boarding passes, make announcements, and ensure efficient passenger boarding. Assist customers during flight irregularities such as delays, cancellations, or diversions, coordinating communication to maintain a positive passenger experience. Maintain excellent customer service standards consistently. Perform duties related to Check-In, Gate, Transfers, and Lost & Found. Charge applicable excess baggage fees. Assist passengers through arrival and check-in processes, including support for unaccompanied minors (UM), VIP passengers, and those requiring wheelchair assistance. Direct passengers through Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine as required. Manage Gate activities, including set-up, communication with the Flight Coordinator, flight close-out, boarding process, and accuracy of final passenger figures. Initiate searches for missing passengers and communicate baggage details for them. Contribute to the on-time performance of flights through proactive handling of Passenger Service matters. Make public address announcements as needed (*, delay, boarding, last call). Assist the Ramp team to ensure wheelchairs, strollers, and gate-checked bags are available for loading upon departure and delivery upon arrival. Adhere to and comply with all Standard Operating Procedures (Swissport & Carrier Specific). Operate equipment such as computer keyboards and carrier-specific reservation/ticketing software. Produce all required work-related documentation. Uphold and protect the company’s interests and image at the Terminal/Airside. Protect customer-supplied products (*, boarding passes, tags, signage) from loss or damage by strictly adhering to procedures. Ensure compliance with uniform standards in line with appearance and personal protective equipment policies. Provide relevant information to customer queries and offer solutions to issues impacting the customer’s experience. Report all irregularities to the appropriate supervisor/manager. Carry out any additional duties as instructed by management. Qualifications and Competencies Demonstrated passion for customer service and relevant work experience. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Commitment to continuous improvement. Self-motivated and capable of working independently. Attentive to detail and numerically proficient. Ability to follow processes and procedures, applying a flexible approach when necessary. Proficiency in typing and willingness to learn airline-specific computer reservation/ticketing software. Willingness to work in various weather conditions. Flexibility to work various shifts, including days, evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with duties extending to Taif. The role requires adaptability to various operational demands, including working in different shifts and potentially inclement weather conditions.

026c715ada75a389.description: About the Role Red Sea Global is seeking a PMO Lead Planning Performance & Transformation for Botanica, a subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. This full-time role is based in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj or Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. The PMO Lead will act as the Operational General Manager's single point of control for planning, performance, and transformation, owning the integrated business plan, KPI scorecard, and strategic initiatives. Company Overview Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, focuses on providing sustainable greenery, integrating new species with local flora. The company operates with a planet-first approach to sustainability across over 1 million square meters. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. The team includes 40% from the local community, committed to ecological harmony and setting new benchmarks in sustainable development. Key Responsibilities Coordinate the annual business plan and budget calendar with Finance and all departments, consolidating an integrated plan. Maintain the financial and operational planning assumptions register and its version history. Manage the portfolio of strategic initiatives, including new revenue streams, capacity expansion, and process improvement, with clear governance and schedules. Prepare and challenge business cases with Finance, tracking benefits post-implementation. Conduct monthly business unit reviews covering revenue, margin, cost, productivity, and service KPIs for each revenue stream. Lead the monthly sales and operations planning (S&OP) cycle, encompassing demand, supply, capacity, cost, and cash. Design the KPI framework and cascade it from Botanica level to departments and sections. Produce monthly performance packs and dashboards, facilitating monthly performance reviews. Track actual versus plan by cost center and contract with Finance, analyzing variances and tracking corrective actions. Maintain the Botanica risk register and RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) with named owners and mitigations. Prepare board papers and GCEO presentation packs, ensuring data integrity. Lead the Planning & Performance and Control sections, building planning, data, and project-control capabilities. Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, and standard operating procedures. Apply and champion the safety, quality, and environmental management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems, processes, and practices. Job Context This role is central to a business with multiple revenue streams and business units that share resources such as people, land, water, and equipment. A primary challenge involves maintaining a single, consistent version of truth across all plans, financial models, and presentations, ensuring reconciliation to confirmed data sources. The PMO Lead must identify and address any conflicts between data sources rather than overlooking them. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to manage integrated business plans and operational planning cycles. Experience in KPI scorecard management and business unit performance reviews. Proficiency in cost and variance control, risk register management, and strategic initiative portfolios. Work Environment The role offers the opportunity to contribute to world-class projects in locations known for their natural beauty, supporting a company that is shaping the future of sustainable tourism and development. Employees work with industry experts in a dynamic environment focused on transforming landscapes and preserving biodiversity.

About SANY Saudi Arabia SANY Saudi Arabia is a company focused on providing heavy equipment solutions. This role is integral to supporting their concrete equipment operations and ensuring customer satisfaction through expert technical service.

029a6122e13dded0.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب أمرك سهل للخدمات الالكترونية عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقه في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة وتدقيق استمارات البيانات، بالإضافة إلى إدخال وتخزين المعلومات باستخدام أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة الاستمارات المتعلقة بالبيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمالها ودقتها. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات إلى الحاسب الآلي وفقاً للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء موجودة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بشكل منظم وآمن. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة لضمان الحفاظ عليها. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج إدخال البيانات وأنظمة الحاسب الآلي. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسرية المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة حائل. سيتم العمل ضمن بيئة مكتبية تتطلب التركيز والدقة في التعامل مع البيانات والمعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

02acf8ffbc735c76.description: About the Role Saudi Entertainment Ventures (SEVEN) is seeking a Future Career Opportunity Attraction Supervisor for a full-time position in Jazan, Jīzān, Saudi Arabia. This role involves managing staff and overseeing attraction operations during assigned shifts, ensuring smooth and efficient functioning while upholding high standards of guest service. The supervisor is key to creating positive guest experiences by leading the team, addressing operational issues, and ensuring compliance with SEVEN's policies. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the team during assigned shifts, ensuring effective performance and adherence to SEVEN's standards. Assign tasks and responsibilities based on operational needs to ensure optimal coverage and service delivery. Provide on-the-spot training, guidance, and support to staff. Monitor and oversee all operational activities, including guest services, equipment maintenance, and safety protocols. Ensure the attraction is clean, well-maintained, and fully operational throughout the shift. Address operational issues and guest concerns promptly, escalating to the Attractions Manager when necessary. Ensure all guests receive high-quality service, focusing on creating a positive and memorable experience. Handle guest inquiries, complaints, and feedback professionally, taking appropriate actions to resolve issues. Promote a culture of guest service excellence among staff. Enforce safety protocols and ensure adherence to SEVEN's safety standards and procedures. Conduct regular checks of equipment and facilities for potential safety hazards or maintenance needs. Prepare shift reports for the Attractions Manager, highlighting operational outcomes, challenges, and recommendations. 02c0d768346d8f09.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن مهندس تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتصميم والإشراف على أنظمة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، مع ضمان الأداء والجودة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معدات وأنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، وتحديد معايير الأداء والجودة المطلوبة. إدارة عمليات تركيب المعدات والأنظمة، بما في ذلك إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تنفيذ برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال هندسة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم عميق لمبادئ تصميم وتشغيل وصيانة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق الهندسية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

02c52645c1e13e34.description: About the Role Aqarat Real Estate Development Company is seeking a Photographer & Visual Content Producer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves capturing and producing professional visual content for land and real estate projects and assets, ensuring their features and benefits are accurately and attractively showcased to support marketing campaigns and presentations. 026a3c5dc8feba1d.description: نحن شركة متخصصة في الخدمات اللوجستية وتوصيل الطلبات (Last-Mile Delivery) نعلن عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى:مدير تشغيل خدمات لوجيستيLogistic Operations Manager *مكان العمل : الرياض* مطلوب: مدير تشغيل لشركة تعمل في مجال الخدمات اللوجستية ( توصيل الطلبات ) Last- Mile Delivery قادر على قيادة وإدارة عمليات التوصيل اليومية، وضمان تحقيق مستويات الخدمة المستهدفة، ورفع كفاءة المناديب والأسطول، وتحسين سرعة وجودة التوصيل مع التحكم في التكاليف التشغيلية *الواجبات الرئيسية:* إدارة عمليات التوصيل اليومية ومتابعة تنفيذ الطلبات من الاستلام حتى التسليم. إدارة ومتابعة أداء المناديب ومشرفي التشغيل. تخطيط وتوزيع المناديب حسب حجم الطلبات والمناطق وأوقات الذروة. متابعة الالتزام بمواعيد التسليم ومستويات الخدمة. مراقبة مؤشرات الأداء التشغيلية وتحليل النتائج واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تحسين إنتاجية المناديب ورفع معدل استغلال الأسطول. متابعة حالات التأخير، الطلبات الملغاة، الطلبات الفاشلة والشكاوى ومعالجتها. تحسين مسارات التوصيل بما يساهم في تقليل الوقت والتكلفة. متابعة جاهزية المركبات والتنسيق مع الصيانة عند الحاجة. إعداد التقارير اليومية والأسبوعية والشهرية للإدارة العليا. إدارة الورديات وتخطيط القوى العاملة وفق حجم الطلبات. تدريب وتطوير المشرفين المناديب ومتابعة التزامهم بالسياسات والإجراءات. التنسيق مع والمنصات وشركاء التوصيل والأقسام الداخلية لحل المشكلات التشغيلية. *المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة :* مؤهل جامعي عالي خبرة 5 سنوات فأكثر في العمليات و الخدمات اللوجستية و توصيل الطلبات و إدارة الأسطول. خبرة سابقة في منصب إشرافي/إداري في Last-Mile Delivery أو Fleet Operations. خبرة في إدارة أعداد كبيرة من السائقين أو مندوبي التوصيل. خبرة في التعامل مع أنظمة إدارة التوصيل والتتبع والتوزيع. قدرة قوية على تحليل البيانات ومؤشرات الأداء. إجادة Microsoft Excel وإعداد التقارير ولوحات المتابعة الخاصة بتطبيقات التوصيل مهارات قوية في القيادة وحل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. القدرة على العمل في بيئة تشغيل سريعة وتحت ضغط، خاصة خلال أوقات الذروة.

0239fa686ff43be0.description: We are seeking an experienced Civil/Structural Designer to join our engineering team.
